title: StashProviderDisabledPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'stash.provider.disabled'. STATE.md S3/K12 (Stash SQLite metadata sync, Lane A): emitted by apps/worker/src/stash/connect.ts whenever a library's configured Stash SQLite database reports a schema_migrations version OUTSIDE the pinned supported range (apps/worker/src/stash/guard.ts's STASH_SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_MIN/MAX) — never best-effort parsing of an unrecognized shape, the provider disables itself outright and this event is the admin-visible record of why. `notice` carries the EXACT S3 wording (guard.ts's formatUnsupportedSchemaNotice), byte-identical to library_stash_connections.status_detail for the same connection, so the two never say something different for the same event. envelope.actorUserId is always null (system-originated: a connect attempt has no human actor in the loop, same posture as probe.failed). ADMIN-ONLY delivery, mirroring probe.failed/scan.completed's operational-event posture — a Stash schema mismatch is instance-configuration diagnostic data, not content any viewer-scoped predicate should gate.

libraryId.description: The library whose library_stash_connections row this connect attempt was for.

seenVersion.description: The Stash schema_migrations.version this connect attempt observed — mirrors library_stash_connections.last_seen_schema_version for the same connection.

supportedMin.description: guard.ts's STASH_SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_MIN at the time this event was written (a value the code, not just this event, enforces — carried here so a historical event remains self-explanatory even after a future PR moves the pinned range).

supportedMax.description: guard.ts's STASH_SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_MAX at the time this event was written — see supportedMin's description.

notice.description: The exact S3 admin notice string, e.g. "Stash schema v58 unsupported; supported: 67-85" — byte-identical to guard.ts's formatUnsupportedSchemaNotice(seenVersion) and to library_stash_connections.status_detail for this connection.
